What it solves: - Source: operator request 2026-08-22, with a screenshot of the eight-tile
  role grid at e.musicalsifu.com, asking for BL-1044's terminal-title change
  ported to that page.
- BL-1044 explicitly listed "the holistic UI" in its own Out of scope, so
  this is its intended sibling rather than an over…
Approval context: Two calls are mine and worth your veto. (1) I scoped this to the HELD form only. BL-1044's not-held form ("the last ticket this pane acted on", read from completed/) needs a resolver nobody has built yet, in a language that may not be reusable here - see notes. Say so if you want the idle form on t…
BL-1046 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1046" (or "reject BL-1046 <reason>") to act.
